$schema_note: Registry of curriculum source documents. Each entry describes ONE official document this platform intends to import. status=PENDING means the document is known to exist but has NOT been downloaded or parsed yet — no content from it exists in the database. status=IMPORTED means the real file is stored under curriculum/sources/caps/ and its checksum verified, but curriculum records extracted from it still land in content_workflow_status=REVIEW_REQUIRED until a human checks them against the source page. See ../../README.md.
